# updates mental tenure

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:updatesMentalTenure`](gmeow-updatesMentalTenure.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/updatesMentalTenure>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/mentation`](../../slices/mentation.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Diachronic transition: relates a mental process to a [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](../classes/gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md) (a held, time-scoped state or tenure) that the process CHANGES — the process revises, extends, or closes a belief tenure, a knowledge tenure, or any other time-scoped mental holding. NOT functional — one process may update several tenures.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:MentalProcess`](../classes/gmeow-MentalProcess.md) -> [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](../classes/gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when the mental process revises, extends, or closes an existing time-scoped holding — a deliberation that updates a belief tenure, a learning episode that revises a knowledge tenure, a recollection that reopens a suppressed tenure. The tenure already existed; the process changes its bounds or content.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it when the process creates something entirely new (use [`gmeow:producesMentalMoment`](gmeow-producesMentalMoment.md)) and avoid it when the process merely manifests an existing capacity (use [`gmeow:realizesMentalMoment`](gmeow-realizesMentalMoment.md)). Not functional — a single episode may update several concurrent tenures.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:updatesMentalTenure`](gmeow-updatesMentalTenure.md) from a [`gmeow:MentalProcess`](../classes/gmeow-MentalProcess.md) to the [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](../classes/gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md) whose bounds or content it changes; track the before/after state by reifying separate tenure individuals.

### Examples

- ex:revisionEpisode [`gmeow:updatesMentalTenure`](gmeow-updatesMentalTenure.md) ex:beliefTenureQEDholds.
